title: Reading Drill — Checking a new market awning — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Checking a new market awning — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Millcross began with reports of water dripping at one end onto a busy walkway. The market buildings team had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using chalk outlines and chose the area wetted during showers as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a slight change in the angle. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted six weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded wind during rain as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
